roles.scope_note: This is reuse of repeat annotations, not evidence of running RepeatMasker. Keep the UCSC resource/build and class definitions explicit; genotype-frequency filters and sequence-synthesis constraints are separate.

The motif examples do not define a complete selection rule or junction-to-BED projection. RepeatMasker search execution is not reported; require explicit motif/resource/build and interval choices rather than guessing them.

The six-type classification and complete/fragment labels are downstream operations. The reference library release, grouping of split insertion records and overlap/extent conventions require review; do not substitute current4.2.6 or treat -nolow as merely an output-row filter.

The paragraph supports annotation reuse, not a new RepeatMasker search. HOMER annotation and R mixtools2.0.0 model P-values are separate; import the exact resources and declare overlap and subclass definitions.

MAKER2, protein-coding gene prediction and transcript assembly are separate. Retain the generated repeat library and the exact historical engine/software choices; printed divergence values do not expose all internal search precision.

Library generation, catalog combination and gene annotation are separate operations. Full RepeatMasker flags and exact library construction are unstated; a supplied-library workflow requires explicit provenance and assembly declarations.

RepeatModeler2 included its LTR-finding module and is separate from RepeatMasker. Species with existing annotations are not automatically new search runs; complete flags and resource releases remain unspecified.

Methods paragraph40 resolves the version/species/default-Dfam choice, but not the exact Dfam release. Targeted BLAST validation, Hi-C/MashMap placement and manual assembly curation remain separate; an official bundled Dfam3.7 resource does not establish the study's exact library identity.

The softmasked product is described for the combined workflow; the exact RepeatMasker masking flag and merge rules are not provided. EDTA and TERL inference remain separate and the library provenance must be explicit.

The paragraph does not specify -noint or its repeat library. TRF, multiple alignment, window/gap filtering, tree-puzzle likelihood tests and R multiple-testing correction are separate; do not infer their settings as RepeatMasker options.

The exact library combination and RepeatMasker flags are not given. RepBase requires an appropriately licensed local resource; RepeatModeler, gene prediction and strict transcript-overlap filtering remain separate. Transcript span versus exon-union denominators are not specified.
